8235.title: Secondary-panel visibility loses keyboard focus
8235.rootCauseOneLine: The shared panel applies inert on close without remembering or restoring focus, and opening has no focus handoff.
8235.proposedFix: Remember a valid outside focus target, restore it on close when appropriate, and focus the active panel control on reopening.
8235.caveats: Production-component Chromium reproduction, repeated from a second clean checkout; packaged desktop and Safari/iOS were not run. Full reproducible fixtures are embedded in the HTML.
